units.source_text: 名人绝不是美男子，也不是富贵相。

en.t: The Master was certainly no handsome man, nor did he have the look of wealth and rank.

units.source_text: 毋宁说是一副粗野的穷相。

en.t: Rather, his face had a rough, impoverished look.

units.source_text: 不论取哪个部分，五官都不美。

en.t: Whichever feature one chose to look at, none of his facial features was beautiful.

units.source_text: 比如说耳朵吧，耳垂像压坏了似的。

en.t: Take his ears, for example: the lobes looked as though they had been crushed.
His mouth was large and his eyes were narrow.

units.source_text: 然而由于长年累月经受棋艺的磨炼，

en.t: Yet because he had been tempered over long years by the art of go,

units.source_text: 他面向棋盘时的形象显得高大而稳重，

en.t: his figure as he faced the board appeared imposing and composed,

units.source_text: 仿佛遗像上也荡漾着灵魂的气息。

en.t: as though even his portrait were suffused with the breath of his soul.

units.source_text: 他像在酣睡，合上的眼睑露出一条细缝，蕴含着深沉的哀愁。

en.t: He seemed to be sleeping soundly; beneath his closed eyelids a thin slit showed, holding a deep sorrow.
